entries.text: Adani Power Limited is India's largest private sector thermal power producer with an operating capacity of 18,330 MW spread across 8 states, and a target capacity of 42,050 MW. The company has a diversified asset portfolio of 14 assets, including supercritical and ultra-supercritical technologies. It has secured revenue visibility with 95% of its operating capacity tied up under long-term and medium-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with state DISCOMs. Adani Power also has in-house coal sourcing and mine-to-plant logistics capabilities, and is expanding into new areas such as hydro power (with an SPV in Bhutan) and nuclear power.

entries.text: Adani Power Limited (APL), a member of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. The company operates an installed thermal power capacity of 15,250 MW, which is distributed across eight power plants located in the states of Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand.
